goals.name: Multi-factor authentication
goals.pledgeText: Within one year of signing the pledge, demonstrate actions taken to measurably increase the use of multi-factor authentication across the manufacturer's products.
goals.description: Increase use of MFA across the manufacturer’s products.

evidenceRequirements.description: MFA adoption rate across customer accounts, over time
Scope of products and account types the rate covers
Independent audit or attestation of the measurement

methodology.summary: Adoption of MFA is measured inside the vendor’s own telemetry. No public source reports it in a form that a third party can check.
methodology.statusRule: Always NOT_EXTERNALLY_VERIFIABLE. A vendor statement is shown as a claim, never as evidence.
limitations: Product documentation can show that MFA is available; it cannot show that it is used.

goals.name: Default passwords
goals.pledgeText: Within one year of signing the pledge, demonstrate measurable progress towards reducing default passwords across the manufacturers' products.

evidenceRequirements.description: Inventory of products and their credential provisioning model
Share of shipped units or deployments with unique or no default credentials

methodology.summary: Verifying default credentials would require testing products or devices. TOUCHSTONE does no testing of vendor products or infrastructure, so it does not measure this goal.
evidenceNeeded: Product inventory with credential provisioning model
limitations: CVE records citing hard-coded credentials (CWE-798) show past defects, not current defaults.

goals.name: Reducing entire classes of vulnerability
goals.pledgeText: Within one year of signing the pledge, demonstrate actions taken towards enabling a significant measurable reduction in the prevalence of one or more vulnerability classes across the manufacturer's products.
goals.description: Reduce the prevalence of one or more vulnerability classes.

evidenceRequirements.description: CWE distribution of the vendor’s own published CVE records over time
Prevalence of the class in shipped code, including undisclosed defects

methodology.summary: TOUCHSTONE reports the share of the vendor’s disclosed CVE records in each tracked weakness class, per year. That is a signal about disclosed vulnerabilities only; it cannot show prevalence in shipped code.
methodology.statusRule: PARTIAL when both trend periods have at least the minimum number of records with a usable CWE; otherwise NOT_VERIFIED. Never VERIFIED: the disclosed mix cannot establish a reduction in prevalence.
evidenceNeeded: Defect data that includes vulnerabilities found and fixed before release
Class definitions mapped to code-level controls (for example memory-safe language adoption)
limitations: Disclosure volume, product mix and CWE assignment practice all move the share without any change in prevalence.
Only records with a CNA-supplied CWE contribute.

goals.name: Security patches
goals.pledgeText: Within one year of signing the pledge, demonstrate actions taken to measurably increase the installation of security patches by customers.
goals.description: Increase customer installation of security patches.

evidenceRequirements.description: Patch installation rates across the customer base, over time

methodology.summary: Patch installation happens inside customer environments. Public sources do not give enough evidence to measure customer installation behaviour independently.
limitations: Internet-wide scan data would require scanning third-party assets, which TOUCHSTONE does not do.

goals.name: Vulnerability disclosure policy
goals.pledgeText: Within one year of signing the pledge, publish a vulnerability disclosure policy (VDP) that authorizes testing by members of the public on products offered by the manufacturer, commits to not recommending or pursuing legal action against anyone engaging in good faith efforts to follow the VDP, provides a clear channel to report vulnerabilities, and allows for public disclosure of vulnerabilities in line with coordinated vulnerability disclosure best practices and international standards.
goals.description: Publish a VDP with the four elements the pledge names.

evidenceRequirements.description: Authorization of testing by the public
Public disclosure allowed in line with coordinated disclosure

methodology.summary: TOUCHSTONE reads the vendor’s public policy (found via security.txt, the vendor registry, or the vendor domain) and assesses eight criteria. Each determination quotes the sentence that supports it. A security.txt file on its own is not counted as a VDP.
methodology.statusRule: VERIFIED when all four pledge-required elements are MET and none is CONTRADICTED. PARTIAL when a policy was found and at least one pledge element is MET. NOT_VERIFIED when no policy was found or no pledge element is MET. DATA_ERROR when the policy could not be retrieved and no earlier snapshot exists.
limitations: Criteria are assessed with documented phrase rules over the policy text. Unusual wording can be missed; every determination carries its quote so it can be checked and disputed.
TOUCHSTONE reads a policy; it does not test whether the vendor honours it.

goals.name: CVEs
goals.pledgeText: Demonstrate transparency in vulnerability reporting by including accurate Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) fields in every Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) record for the manufacturer's products. Additionally, issue CVEs in a timely manner for, at minimum, all critical or high impact vulnerabilities (whether discovered internally or by a third party) that either require actions by a customer to patch or have evidence of active exploitation.
goals.description: CWE and CPE in every CVE record; timely CVEs for critical and high impact vulnerabilities.

evidenceRequirements.description: CVE records for the vendor’s products, with the CNA container
Vendor advisories stating severity and CVE ids, with release dates

methodology.summary: Two measured dimensions. Record quality: the share of eligible CVE records whose CNA-supplied data includes a valid CWE and a well-formed CPE in the vendor’s namespace. Issuance timeliness: for critical and high advisories, whether a CVE record exists and how long after the advisory it was published.
methodology.statusRule: DATA_ERROR when the CVE source failed with no earlier snapshot. VERIFIED when every eligible record is complete (the pledge says "every") AND every high-impact advisory has a CVE published within the methodology tolerance, over at least the minimum number of high-impact advisories. PARTIAL when either dimension has evidence but falls short (including timeliness measured on fewer advisories than the minimum). When neither dimension can be measured: NOT_VERIFIED when the records are below the minimum sample (or there are none) AND there are no high-impact advisories to measure (no advisory feed, or none in the window); DATA_ERROR when a source or mapping problem prevents measurement (for example no CPE vendor namespace is registered, so completeness cannot be checked).
limitations: Third-party enrichment (CISA-ADP, NVD) is reported but not credited to the vendor.
A vulnerability that was never disclosed cannot be counted.
Timeliness needs a machine-readable advisory feed (CSAF). Without one, timeliness is NOT_VERIFIED, not zero.

goals.name: Evidence of intrusions
goals.pledgeText: Within one year of signing the pledge, demonstrate a measurable increase in the ability for customers to gather evidence of cybersecurity intrusions affecting the manufacturer's products.
goals.description: Increase customers’ ability to gather intrusion evidence.

evidenceRequirements.description: Logging capabilities available to customers, by product and tier, over time
Whether those capabilities are enabled and retained by default

methodology.summary: Logging features are sometimes documented publicly, but documentation does not show availability by licence tier, default configuration, or change over time in a comparable way.
evidenceNeeded: Per-product logging capability inventory with licence tier
Change log over the pledge year
limitations: Counting documentation pages would measure documentation, not capability.

metricDefinitions.name: VDP criteria met
metricDefinitions.formula: (criteria MET + 0.5 × criteria PARTIAL) ÷ 8 criteria × 100. NOT_MET, CONTRADICTED and UNKNOWN count 0; every UNKNOWN criterion is listed by name. Not reported when no criterion could be determined.
metricDefinitions.eligibility: Vendors with a VDP observation in the run (security.txt and/or a policy page). A security.txt file on its own is not counted as a policy.

metricDefinitions.name: Pledge VDP elements met
metricDefinitions.formula: Count of the four pledge elements (reporting channel, testing authorized, good-faith safe harbor, public disclosure allowed) assessed MET. PARTIAL, NOT_MET, CONTRADICTED and UNKNOWN are not counted. Not reported when all four are UNKNOWN.
metricDefinitions.eligibility: Vendors with a VDP observation in the run.

metricDefinitions.name: CNA-supplied CWE coverage
metricDefinitions.formula: Eligible records whose CNA container lists a usable CWE ÷ eligible records × 100. A usable CWE is a CWE-<n> identifier; NVD-CWE-noinfo and NVD-CWE-Other count as usable only when the methodology parameter placeholderCweCountsAsPopulated is true (1.0.0: true, 1.1.0: false). CWEs supplied only by an ADP container (CISA-ADP, NVD) are not credited.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: Eligible records with a usable CNA CWE
metricDefinitions.eligibility: CVE records attributed to the vendor (not excluded), in state PUBLISHED, with datePublished within cveWindowDays before asOf. Reported only when the denominator reaches minimumEligibleRecords.

metricDefinitions.name: CNA-supplied CPE coverage
metricDefinitions.formula: Eligible records whose CNA container lists at least one well-formed CPE 2.3 name ÷ eligible records × 100. CPEs supplied only by an ADP container are not credited.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: Eligible records with a well-formed CNA CPE
metricDefinitions.eligibility: CVE records attributed to the vendor (not excluded), in state PUBLISHED, with datePublished within cveWindowDays before asOf. Reported only when the denominator reaches minimumEligibleRecords.

metricDefinitions.name: CPE vendor namespace consistency
metricDefinitions.formula: Records with at least one well-formed CNA CPE whose vendor field matches one of the vendor’s registered CPE_VENDOR aliases ÷ records with at least one well-formed CNA CPE × 100. Not reported when the registry lists no CPE_VENDOR alias for the vendor.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: Records with a CNA CPE in the vendor’s namespace
metricDefinitions.denominatorLabel: Eligible records with a well-formed CNA CPE
metricDefinitions.eligibility: Eligible records (as for cve.cwe_coverage) that carry at least one well-formed CNA CPE. Reported only when that count reaches minimumEligibleRecords.

metricDefinitions.name: Complete CVE records (CNA-supplied)
metricDefinitions.formula: Eligible records whose CNA container has BOTH a usable CWE AND a well-formed CPE in the vendor’s CPE namespace ÷ eligible records × 100. The pledge asks for CWE and CPE in every record, so this is the CVE record quality figure.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: Eligible records complete in the CNA container
metricDefinitions.eligibility: As for cve.cwe_coverage. Not reported when the registry lists no CPE_VENDOR alias for the vendor (namespace cannot be checked).

metricDefinitions.name: Fields supplied only by third-party enrichment
metricDefinitions.formula: Eligible records lacking a usable CNA CWE or a well-formed CNA CPE for which an ADP container (for example CISA-ADP) supplies the missing field ÷ eligible records × 100. Context only: never credited to the vendor.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: Eligible records completed only by ADP data

metricDefinitions.name: Duplicate CVE records with conflicting content
metricDefinitions.formula: Count of CVE ids that appear more than once in the snapshot with different content hashes and name this vendor as a candidate. Both copies are excluded from every metric. Data quality, not a quality signal.
metricDefinitions.eligibility: Attribution exclusions with reason DUPLICATE_CONFLICT whose candidate vendors include this vendor.

metricDefinitions.name: Records excluded from attribution
metricDefinitions.formula: Count of CVE records naming this vendor as a candidate that were excluded by an attribution rule (ambiguous vendor, identity conflict, rejected record, duplicate conflict). Data quality, not a quality signal.
metricDefinitions.eligibility: Attribution exclusions whose candidate vendors include this vendor.

metricDefinitions.name: High-impact advisories with a CVE record
metricDefinitions.formula: High-impact advisories listing at least one CVE id that exists as a PUBLISHED record in the snapshot ÷ high-impact advisories × 100. High impact = the advisory’s stated severity is in highImpactSeverities (CRITICAL, HIGH).
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: High-impact advisories with a CVE record in the snapshot
metricDefinitions.eligibility: The vendor’s machine-readable advisories (CSAF) published within cveWindowDays before asOf with a stated CRITICAL or HIGH severity. No advisories at all: not measured (NO_SOURCE), not zero.

metricDefinitions.name: Timely CVE issuance for high-impact advisories
metricDefinitions.formula: High-impact advisories where every listed CVE exists in the snapshot and was published no later than timelinessToleranceDays after the advisory ÷ high-impact advisories × 100. The tolerance is a TOUCHSTONE methodology parameter, not a CISA threshold. An advisory listing no CVE, or a CVE absent from the snapshot, is not counted as timely.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: High-impact advisories with all CVEs published within tolerance

metricDefinitions.name: CVE publication latency after advisory
metricDefinitions.formula: Per high-impact advisory: the latest datePublished among its listed CVE records minus the advisory’s initial release date, in days (sign kept: negative means the CVE was public before the advisory). Reported as median, 75th and 95th percentile (nearest-rank) over advisories; the value is the median.
metricDefinitions.eligibility: High-impact advisories (as above) with at least one listed CVE present in the snapshot with a datePublished.

metricDefinitions.name: Tracked weakness-class share, change over 12 months
metricDefinitions.formula: Share of the vendor’s records with a CNA-supplied CWE identifier that fall in a tracked class (memory safety, injection, authentication and credentials), latest 12 months minus prior 12 months, in percentage points. Per-class shares are in the breakdown. A signal about disclosed records only; it cannot establish a change in prevalence.
metricDefinitions.numeratorLabel: Latest-period records in a tracked class
metricDefinitions.denominatorLabel: Latest-period records with a CNA CWE identifier
metricDefinitions.eligibility: Attributed PUBLISHED records with at least one CNA CWE identifier (placeholders name no class and never contribute). Latest period: the 365 days up to asOf; prior period: the 365 days before that. Reported only when each period has at least minimumRecordsPerTrendPeriod records.
